title: Snap 推出全新 Specs AI 工具，即将登陆 iOS 和 Mac
summary: Snap 正在推出名为“Specs Intelligence”的全新 AI 助手，该工具能够连接其他数字账户，帮助用户处理工作任务和跟踪旅行信息等事务。从功能描述来看，Specs Intelligence 与 Meta 的 Muse 和 Gemini 的 Spark 等 AI 助手类似，但 Snap 将其定位为一种更智能、更个性化的助手体验。目前，Snap 并未透露该工具的具体技术细节和完整功能列表，但确认它将登陆 iOS 和 Mac 平台。此举标志着 Snap 在 AI 助手领域的进一步布局，旨在通过跨账户集成提升用户生产力，并与现有主流 AI 助手展开竞争。Specs Intelligence 的推出可能为 Snap 生态带来新的交互方式，但其实际表现和用户接受度仍有待观察。
summary_en: Snap is launching "Specs Intelligence," a new AI assistant that can connect other digital accounts to help with tasks like work and tracking travel information. It appears similar to AI assistants such as Meta's Muse and Gemini's Spark, though Snap positions Specs Intelligence as a more intelligent and personalized assistant experience. The company has not disclosed specific technical details or a full feature list, but confirmed it will arrive on iOS and Mac. This move marks Snap's further push into the AI assistant space, aiming to boost user productivity through cross-account integration and compete with existing mainstream AI assistants. The launch could bring new interaction methods to the Snap ecosystem, but its actual performance and user adoption remain to be seen.
